_comment: Joint-level tokenization variant of the flow-matching baseline. VelocityNet emits one token per (frame, joint) pair (T*J = 81*17 = 1377 tokens) instead of one token per frame (T = 81). The transformer body (d_model=256, nhead=8, num_layers=6, ff_dim=1024) is identical to the frame-tokenised config so parameter counts are nearly identical, allowing a clean architectural ablation. batch_size is dropped from 128 to 32 to keep attention memory in check (1377**2 is ~290x more than 81**2). Per-joint learned positional embedding is added on top of the sinusoidal frame PE.
